value.summary: Measured exact relaxed 77-to-80 relative grain translation using 11052 matched IDs and source-cell all-axis MIC. 20 Å FCC interiors yield top-minus-bottom (+0.195673781,+0.000000643,+0.061142988) Å, XZ norm 0.205004130 Å; exclusion sensitivity below 1e-7 Å for mean. Includes signed distribution statistics, residuals, cubic coefficients and FCC translation residual tests.
value.task: Small custom measurement not supported Analysis: quantify relative grain shift for consecutive all-free relaxed postdrop frames reference original77 current80. Parse exact staged CFGs using available ovito/numpy (no ASE available). Match unique Particle Identifier validate11052IDs same cells. Compute current-reference minimum-image with source periodic cell all axes, no alignment/affine/drift subtraction. Current Y-normal GB y=-0.700778484 A, top positiveY plane(110),bottom negativeY plane(111); derive occupied grain Y extents and define reproducible far-field masks excluding >=20A from GB and >=20A from occupied outer Y surfaces (not box boundaries vacuum). Use reference Y masks and same IDs, crystalline interior; if use CNA record. Sensitivity repeat exclusions10,20,30A or central grain bands to verify robust. Report top/bottom count signed xyz mean/median std/MAD/p10p90, top-minus-bottom mean and median xyz,XZ norm with uncertainties/sensitivity; residual displacement after subtract each grain mean to distinguish collective translations vs local distortions. Validate global/slab magnitudes reproduce known all median.134172max.372205A approximately. Need actual relative shift numerical not infer from arrow. Full orientation topx[001]y[110]z[-1,1,0];bottomx[1,-2,1]y[111]z[-1,0,1],FCCa0=3.52A. Transform measured shift from simulation xyz to EACH grain local cubic coords via normalized basis columns to express in a[uvw] coefficients (do not round to integer Burgers vector). Test nearest FCC translation for each using integer/half integer cubic lattice sum rule, report distance residual, but relative shift needn't be either grain lattice vector/DSC; do not claim dislocation. Equal energy not same coordinates, arbitrary common translation removed only by relative top-bottom difference. Publish compact JSON and readable report/table + script. Both inputs structure-minimize-20261021-220732-c86c47 minimized_cfg exact artifacts as supplied,not constrained shearframes.
